simple.meaning: עוֹף (ʻôwph) is a Hebrew word meaning “fowl.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עוֹף (H5776) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 2:38, with occurrences in Daniel.
